env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A tuple literal holds any lowered element at any position: a ?? over
# an option or a map read, a map read or ?. that stays an option, an
# interpolated string, and a call whose argument holds a ??. The
# literal is a plain statement value, a destructured value, a nested
# literal, a returned value, an argument and a slice element. The
# module runs natively, ejects, and the ejected module builds and runs
# with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and prints the same ok
# lines.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_option_elements.lgo m/main.lgo
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_option_elements.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_option_elements.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_option_elements.out
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/tupleoptionelements

go 1.27
